subject: Admin activity exports: export window, redaction checklist and delivery plan
messages:
From: Andrew Park <andrew.park@novamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: 2027-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: admin activity exports for upcoming audit

Hi Kimberly,

We have an external SOC 2 readiness review next week and need a one-off export of admin activity for the past 18 months (Jan 2026 - Jul 2027). Specifically: account admin actions (create/delete/role-change), privileged session starts/stops, and API key lifecycle events.

Can you confirm:
- The canonical field list you can provide (names, timestamps, actor id, service, action_type, request_id, ip_address)
- Retention windows available and whether partial-month sampling is possible for older data
- Redaction options for PII fields (email, username) and whether we can receive a manifest + checksum for chain-of-custody

We can accept a presigned S3 link. Also please include a small sample payload (100 lines) so our audit team can validate formatting.

Thanks,
Andrew Park
Sr. Security Engineer
NovaMed Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Park <andrew.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports for upcoming audit

Hi Andrew — thanks for the details. Short answer: yes, we can produce that export and supply a sample. Ill outline what we can provide and the options.

What we log (canonical fields):
- timestamp (ISO8601, UTC)
- actor_principal (internal id + email when available)
- actor_role (role at time of event)
- action_type (e.g., ADMIN.CREATE_USER, ADMIN.DELETE_API_KEY, PRIVILEGED_SESSION.START)
- target_resource (resource id, type)
- request_id (server-assigned UUID)
- request_path (API endpoint)
- client_ip (IP or NAT gateway)
- user_agent
- outcome (SUCCESS/FAILURE/error_code)

Retention and sampling:
- Full raw ledger available for 24 months by default for enterprise-tier accounts. For older data past 24 months we can provide aggregated summaries only.
- We can create a timeboxed raw export for Jan 2026-Jul 2027 (18 months) but this will require a staging job that can take up to 48 hours for snapshot and verification.
- If the auditor prefers sampling, we can produce stratified samples (by month and action_type) or deterministic downsample (1-in-N) with a signed manifest.

Redaction options and chain-of-custody:
- PII redaction: we can zero-out or hash
  - zero-out: replace email/username fields with [REDACTED_EMAIL]
  - hash: SHA256 hex with per-export salt (salt included in signed manifest only)
- Export manifest: CSV with record counts, start/end timestamps, manifest checksum (sha256), and HMAC-SHA256 signature of the tarball (signed by our key).

Delivery and access:
- Preferred: presigned S3 link (7-day expiry) + manifest and size checksum delivered via our secure transfer system.
- Alternate: encrypted FTP or an enterprise SFTP endpoint if your SOC team prefers.

Ill coordinate with Ops for the staging job. Can you confirm the delivery window you need and whether you want hashed or zeroed PII in the sample?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Compliance Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports for upcoming audit

Kim, looping Ops. Quick notes for the export job:
- Create export job with id: export_novamed_20270825. Include a small sample payload (export_payload_sample.jsonl, 100 lines).
- Redaction default: hash emails with per-export salt unless customer explicitly requests zero-out. Hashing preserves uniqueness for auditor correlation without exposing PII.
- Include these additional fields in manifest: file_size_bytes, sha256_of_file, record_count_by_action_type (JSON blob), export_tool_version.

Ops ETA: snapshot job submitted at 11:30PT, estimated completion 36-48h. Will attach staged tarball to s3://redwood-evidence/novamed/ on success and generate presigned URL.

Attachments for this thread: admin_activity_export_manifest.csv (example), redaction_field_map_v1.xlsx (column list).

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Andrew Park <andrew.park@novamed.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com

Thanks — that sounds good. Hashing with per-export salt is the preferred approach for our auditor. Delivery: presigned S3 link is fine; we need the manifest and HMAC within the same transfer.

One more ask: can you include a short README in the tarball that describes the field schema and the time zone normalization (you said UTC) so we can point the auditor to the exact parsing steps?

If ETA is 36-48h, well plan for a Thursday delivery. Please mark the export as high priority.

—Andrew
